relations.title: Check modulus survival under thermal and nonlinear evolution
relations.rationale: For a specified stabilization framework with displaced moduli, thermal and nonlinear evolution tests whether its vacuum survives the relevant cosmological history. This supplies a reliability check on the stabilization branch of s16.

Thermal changes to a potential, actual runaway, overshoot and nonlinear fragmentation remain distinct. Removal of a static minimum does not establish cosmological escape, and no universal stability or instability follows.
